sips.title: The boats decide the days
sips.what_changes: Both planting days strand without boat transport. The fishers' offer exists; pairing it with crew lunch closes the logistics gap.

sips.title: Four hundred propagules short
sips.what_changes: 800 in hand, 1,200 planned. The county scheme and the nursery action both land here — whoever fills the gap sets the planting-day scope.

sips.title: Small pledges doubled by the match
sips.what_changes: Twelve donors pledged $180 against unmet needs; the $500 fund can match every dollar and still leave room — the round is the cheapest coverage available.
